name: email
description: Sends T-Attention messages by email from your own mailbox over SMTP (Gmail and 163 Mail built in, or any SMTP server).

options.label: Gmail
options.help: Gmail needs 2-Step Verification on the Google account. Then create an app password at https://myaccount.google.com/apppasswords and enter it below. Your Google password does not work here.

options.label: 163 Mail (NetEase)
options.help: 163 Mail: on mail.163.com open Settings, then POP3/SMTP/IMAP, turn on the SMTP service and copy the authorization code it shows. Enter that code below; your login password does not work here.

options.label: Other SMTP server
options.help: Enter the SMTP server, port and security from your provider's help page. Most providers want an app password here, not the login password.

config.label: Sender email address
config.help: The mailbox that sends the emails. It also logs in to the SMTP server.

config.label: App password or authorization code
config.help: Gmail: the app password. 163: the authorization code. Never the login password. It is stored encrypted and never shown again.

config.label: Send to (optional)
config.help: One or more addresses, separated by commas. Empty: the emails go to the sender address.

config.label: Sender name
config.help: The name the emails come from.

options.label: None (only for a server on this computer)

config.label: Port
config.help: Empty: 465 for SSL/TLS, 587 for STARTTLS, 25 for none.
